transform: log1p outcome; numeric predictors in native transformed units

model_sequence.step1: global Moran I on transformed y and OLS residuals; 9,999 permutations; Holm adjustment across the six cases for each measure
model_sequence.step2: LM-lag, robust LM-lag, LM-error, robust LM-error, joint SARMA and joint SDM tests on OLS residuals; Holm adjustment by test across six cases
model_sequence.step3: Gaussian ML LR comparisons: SDM vs SAR (theta=0), SDEM vs SEM (theta=0), GNS vs SDM (lambda=0); Holm adjustment by comparison across six cases
model_sequence.step4: AIC/BIC ranks are reported mechanically for human selection; the script does not declare a scientific winner or interpret coefficients causally

caveats: Exploratory cross-sectional associations, not causal effects.
Classic LM and Gaussian ML comparisons assume homoskedastic innovations; HC3 OLS standard errors do not change the LM test assumptions.
Reported deforestation outcomes are complete cases among reporting units; non-reporting is not coded as zero.
Queen isolates are retained; kNN connects islands to their nearest territories, which can be distant or separated by water.
No final model is selected automatically; AIC/BIC ranks and nested test outcomes are reported as model-comparison evidence.

territory_crosswalk.FRA: Natural Earth ADM0_A3 key; overseas polygons split by location.
territory_crosswalk.NOR: Svalbard and Jan Mayen split from Norway by location.
territory_crosswalk.BES: Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba split from the Netherlands multipolygon.
territory_crosswalk.TKL: Tokelau split from New Zealand multipolygon.
territory_crosswalk.GIB: No polygon in Natural Earth 50m; excluded.
